arguments.command:

python3 - <<'EOF'
from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

# distinct PNs coalesced I packets
e0 = envelope('I', 0, b'\x01'); e1 = envelope('I', 1, b'\x01')
tr = trace([datagram(e0+e1, auth=[0,0])])
check("ih-two-distinct", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK','packets.1.status':'OK','received.I':1})

# stream cat-2 receive ok, send ref PV
s2 = stream(2, 0, b'a', fin=False)   # id 2 = client-uni
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, s2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("stream-cat2", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'opened.uni':1})
msd = bytes([0x11]) + W.v(6) + W.v(5)   # id 6 = cat 2 idx 1 -> send ref -> PV
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, msd, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("msd-cat2", tr, {'packets.0.status':'STREAM_STATE_ERROR'})

# send ref to server-bidi ok / server-uni ok
stop1 = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(1) + W.v(5)   # id 1 cat1 idx0 < localBidi=1
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, stop1, width=1), auth=[0])], local_bidi=1)
check("stop-cat1", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.stop':5})
stop3 = bytes([0x05]) + W.v(3) + W.v(5)   # id 3 cat3 idx0 < localUni=1
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, stop3, width=1), auth=[0])], local_uni=1)
check("stop-cat3", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'streams.0.stop':5})

# client stream limit: idx >= limits.bidi -> STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR
s = stream(8, 0, b'a')  # id 8 idx 2
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, s, width=1), auth=[0])], bidi=2)
check("stream-limit", tr, {'packets.0.status':'STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR'})

# stream limit rollback of implicit opening on error
s = stream(12, 0, b'a') + b'\x99'  # id 12 idx 3, limits.bidi=8 -> opens 4 then error
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, s, width=1), auth=[0])], bidi=8)
check("open-rollback", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'opened.bidi':0})

# CRYPTO offset overflow -> FE
c = bytes([0x06]) + W.v(2**62-1) + W.v(2) + b'ab'
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, c, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("crypto-overflow", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# truncated frame body -> FE at frame offset
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01\x06', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("truncated", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'closed.offset':1})

# PATH frames: 8 bytes each, truncated -> FE
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x1a\x01\x02', width=1), auth=[0])])
check("path-trunc", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# NCID truncated token
ncid = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*15
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ncid, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ncid-trunc", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# NCID cidlen 0 and 21 -> FE
for cl in (0, 21):
    ncid = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(0) + bytes([cl]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*16
    tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ncid, width=1), auth=[0])])
    check(f"ncid-cidlen-{cl}", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# NCID rpt > seq -> FE
ncid = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(2) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*16
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, ncid, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ncid-rpt", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR'})

# NCID active accounting: seq 0 removed via rpt=1 keeps count<=limit; add seq2 with rpt0
n1 = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(2) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xee' + b'\x22'*16
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, n1, width=1), auth=[0])], cids=2)
check("ncid-count-ok", tr, {'packets.0.status':'OK', 'peer_cids':[{'sequence':0,'id':'cc','token':'00'*16},{'sequence':2,'id':'ee','token':'22'*16}]})

# NEW_CONNECTION_ID at I level -> PV
ncid = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*16
tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, ncid, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ncid-level", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})
EOF
